name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.5.0 (released 2026-07-04, 238 commits since v0.4.0) is a major release introducing Connect Knowledge (Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive, Dropbox read-only integration), a 52-connector Integrations Hub (Slack, Google, Microsoft 365, Snowflake, LinkedIn, Discord, Telegram), and per-room agent Channels. Security improvements include PBKDF2 password hashing with per-install salt and login rate-limiting. v0.6.0 introduces a self-update mechanism, with future releases published at https://github.com/cabinetai/cabinet-releases.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — v0.5.0 released 2026-07-04 with 238 commits, v0.6.0 followed shortly after
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Yes — password-based auth with PBKDF2 hashing, per-install salt, login rate-limiting, and mobile/reverse-proxy support

breaking_excerpts: Clean-path routing: the app serves clean URLs instead of hash routes across web and Electron; old hash links resolve via a marker-scan parser but canonical form is now path-based.
Channels on-disk rename: the internal team-chat directory moved from '.slack' to '.channels', scoped per room.
v0.6.0 moves the update mechanism to a new release channel at https://github.com/cabinetai/cabinet-releases.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more powerful document indexing and OCR capabilities than Cabinet, but comes with a heavier setup and resource footprint.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell provides robust document processing and full-text search but requires more configuration effort compared to Cabinet's lightweight approach.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy is a more feature-rich document management system with workflow support, but is heavier and more complex to deploy than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud
alternatives.review: Nextcloud is a full productivity suite with file management included, making it far heavier than Cabinet but offering a much broader ecosystem.

alternatives.name: Mayan EDMS
alternatives.review: Mayan EDMS is an enterprise-grade document management system with extensive features, but its complexity and resource requirements far exceed Cabinet's lightweight philosophy.
